risk_if_not_implemented: Without Attribute Value Changes By Authorized Individuals, sensitive and/or regulated data may be disclosed, altered or lost through inadequate classification, handling or protection. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Unauthorized Modification / Loss of System Integrity (R-AM-2), Unaddressed Security / Compliance Exposure (R-GV-2), and most likely increases susceptibility to Human Error (MT-9).

compensating_control_1.name: Data & Asset Classification
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to ensure data and assets are categorized in accordance with applicable statutory, regulatory and contractual requirements.
compensating_control_1.justification: Data & Asset Classification (DCH-04) provides overlapping security capability that compensates for the absence of Attribute Value Changes By Authorized Individuals (DCH-37.2) by addressing related risk objectives through an alternative control mechanism aligned with Technology applicability. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Cybersecurity & Data Protection Attributes
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to bind cybersecurity and data protection attributes to information as it is stored, transmitted and processed.
compensating_control_2.justification: Cybersecurity & Data Protection Attributes (DCH-37) provides overlapping security capability that compensates for the absence of Attribute Value Changes By Authorized Individuals (DCH-37.2) by addressing related risk objectives through an alternative control mechanism aligned with Technology applicability. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
